sections.heading: Decision: Use Reciprocal Rank Fusion for hybrid search
sections.body: Hybrid search fuses lexical and vector result lists with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) rather than a weighted score sum. RRF is rank-based so it is robust to the incomparable score scales of BM25 and cosine similarity, which a weighted sum is not. Rejected alternative: linear score combination (rejected: requires per-query score normalization that is brittle across corpora). Evidence: pathfinder PR #214.
